purpose: Name the most likely reviewer objections and required evidence before treating the grounded-QA distillation project as paper-ready.

risks.reviewer_objection: The paper question asks whether expensive grounded behavior can be distilled into a cheaper trained model or scaffold, but the final Qwen 3B joint-action student has not been trained/evaluated.
risks.mitigation_done: The dataset packet, bounded GPU runner, adapter eval, smoke manifest, and budgeted launch command are prepared and validated. joint-action-packet-quality-audit-2026-06-26-v1 verifies 244 SFT rows and 80 DPO rows with both repair and abstain preferences, no missing inline citations in grounded targets, and no train/eval paper overlap. final-evidence-checklist-qwen3b-2026-06-26-v1 enumerates the exact final artifacts that must exist before this blocker can close.

risks.reviewer_objection: No paper-ready claim can be made about citation-grounded correctness until the trained student's predictions are judged for support and abstention correctness.
risks.mitigation_done: A fail-closed post-smoke pipeline now runs prediction integrity checks and dry judging before any paid OpenAI judge call.
required_next_evidence: Dry judge covers all 69 final-window examples
Paid openai-judge run with positive calls_made and examples_judged

risks.reviewer_objection: The motivating claim says private evolving KBs, while the current evaluation is a public QASPER/arXiv proxy.
risks.mitigation_done: The manuscript evidence map and draft restrict the claim to a trusted dated public proxy and explicitly prohibit private-KB proof language.
required_next_evidence: Keep the manuscript caveat unless a versioned private/domain corpus is added.
If adding a private KB, create train-time and final-time snapshots with immutable date provenance.

risks.reviewer_objection: The contribution may be perceived as generic RAG distillation, generic citation SFT, or KB write-back memory rather than a sharper grounded-correctness amortization result.
risks.mitigation_done: Current artifacts isolate the support/abstention/citation-grounding axis and scope out write-back retrieval until leakage-safe memory snapshots exist.
required_next_evidence: Refresh web/paper search immediately before any submission claim.
Update related-work notes with any June 2026 or newer direct overlaps.

risks.reviewer_objection: A model-based grounded-correctness judge can be biased, under-calibrated, or insufficient as the only correctness authority.
risks.mitigation_done: The judge artifacts store structured support verdicts, judge-calibration-audit-2026-06-26-v1 samples 26 hard rows from 447 existing judgments, judge-adjudication-packet-2026-06-26-v1 joins those rows to questions/evidence/predictions with 0 join warnings, judge-reliability-second-pass-plan-2026-06-26-v1 prepares 26 blind second-pass request rows, judge-reliability-second-pass-run-2026-06-26-v2 completes 42 blind second-pass case judgments with 0 schema violations and 76.2% exact agreement, and abstention-boundary-reliability-audit-2026-06-26-v1 flags questionable abstentions as unstable.
required_next_evidence: Manually adjudicate the joined judge adjudication packet or run the planned blind second-judge pass before submission if budget/time permits.
Report judge prompts, schemas, abstention criteria, and disagreement examples.

risks.reviewer_objection: The strongest completed scaffold results improve support largely by suppressing risky answers, so correctness gains may hide poor answer coverage.
risks.mitigation_done: cost-coverage-support-pareto-2026-06-26-v1 maps 6 current systems across answer rate, answer support, judged correctness, citation recall, and online calls/query; post-training-policy-ablation-2026-06-26-v1 aggregates existing judged post-training/data policies and shows support-risk gated labels are strongest by judged correctness/support but answer only 57.6% of rows; coverage-constrained-support-frontier-2026-06-26-v1 replays thresholds and shows the 70% answer-rate operating point reaches 68.5% answer support and 77.3% judged correctness; the draft frames coverage as a central metric.
required_next_evidence: Report answer rate, abstention correctness, support, and utility together.
Compare trained Qwen 3B against zero-call gates on both correctness and coverage.

risks.reviewer_objection: The paper-critical run depends on external GPU execution, while Prime auth and HF credits are currently unavailable.
risks.mitigation_done: The remote command is single-step and bounded; prime-cli-upgrade-auth-recheck-2026-06-26-v1 upgraded/rechecked Prime CLI 0.6.15 and still found API-key authorization failures before pricing or balance checks. All actual spend is tracked under the $100 budget with $0 external compute spend so far.
required_next_evidence: Install a valid Prime key through hidden input or repair HF credits.
Record provider, GPU type, wall time, cost, and command transcript for the smoke.

acceptance_path: Repair Prime auth or HF credits without exceeding the $100 total budget.
Run the one-command bounded Qwen 3B SFT/DPO smoke and produce complete predictions.
Run the Qwen 3B prediction integrity gate and default post-smoke dry judge.
Run the paid grounded-correctness judge only after the dry gate passes.
Refresh the novelty watchlist/web search immediately before making a submission-ready claim.
Regenerate the evidence map, manuscript draft, readiness gate, and this risk audit.
